extraction.payment_terms: Annual subscription fee of $420,000 invoiced on anniversary date. Implementation fee of $180,000 in two equal installments. Annual increases capped at 5% with 90 days' notice.
key_clauses: Intellectual Property — All IP in Software remains with Licensor; no reverse engineering, decompiling, or disassembly permitted
Data Ownership — All Licensee data remains Licensee property; data export in CSV/JSON within 30 days of termination
SLA — 99.9% uptime for cloud-hosted components; credits of 5% per 0.1% below target, capped at 30% of monthly fee
Limitation of Liability — Capped at fees paid in preceding 12 months; no consequential or indirect damages
Warranties — Software substantially conforms to documentation; excludes unauthorized modifications or third-party integrations
termination_conditions: Material breach by either Party with 30 days' written notice and cure period
Convenience termination by Licensee after initial term with 90 days' notice
Immediate termination by Licensor for license scope violations (exceeding 500 users, unauthorized copying)
Licensee must cease use and certify destruction of all copies within 30 days

obligations.obligation: Provide software updates and patches at no additional cost
24/7 technical support (4-hour response for critical, 24-hour for non-critical)
12 months advance notice for end-of-life of any component
Maintain accurate user counts and report quarterly
Install security patches within 30 days of release
Not share access credentials or allow unauthorized access

extraction.governing_law: State of Washington; arbitration in Seattle under AAA rules

clauses.notes: Standard for software licensing; Licensor retains full ownership. No risk to Licensee as long as license is maintained.
Strong data ownership clause; CSV/JSON export within 30 days is favorable. Consider specifying data format schemas.
99.9% allows ~8.7 hours downtime/year. Credit cap of 30% limits financial recourse. No penalty for repeated SLA misses. Consider adding termination right for persistent SLA failures.
Auto-renewal with 90-day opt-out window creates lock-in risk if deadline is missed. Calendar reminders recommended.
5% annual cap means subscription could reach $486K by year 3. Over 36-month term, total subscription cost: $1.32M+.
12-month rolling cap means exposure is limited to ~$420K even for catastrophic failures. No carve-outs for data breach or gross negligence — this is unfavorable to Licensee.
